responsibilities: ROLE & RES PONS IB IL ITY
Part of a 24×7 rotational shift team providing critical in-life support for enterprise security infrastructure.
Deliver Level 3 support for complex and escalated security incidents, ensuring timely resolution in line with SLAs.
Work on complex network security architectures, including handling incidents, changes, and problems across DC (Data Center) and DR (Disaster Recovery) environments.
Participate in DC/DR drills and manage high-availability configurations for critical security infrastructure.
Configure and upgrade Infra devices including firewalls, proxies, VPN appliances, and other perimeter security systems.
Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis of escalated incidents in collaboration with application support teams in UAT and production environments.
Familiar with and apply industry-standard security practices and compliance requirements
Conduct thorough threat detection, incident response, and remediation activities, ensuring containment and recovery.
Analyze customer network/security posture and propose risk mitigation strategies or architecture improvements.
Mentor and guide Level 1 analysts; provide operational documentation and ensure knowledge transfer.
Ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal security policies.
Collaborate professionally with internal teams and external clients during security incident handling or troubleshooting.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to security policies, firewall rules, device health, and connectivity.
Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for operational security support and escalations.
Maintain operational efficiency by adhering to ITIL processes and using ticketing tools such as ServiceNow and Remedy.
Ensure ongoing compliance with SEBI and other regulatory frameworks by updating the network security model as per latest guidelines and circulars.
Actively support and respond to internal and external audits; resolve audit findings within defined timelines.
Perform scheduled security maintenance such as log backups, firewall policy reviews, access audits (VPN, proxy, administrative), and compliance checks.
Team Management: Responsible for preparing rosters, managing leaves, and organizing shift schedules for 24×7 operations.

Project Management: Handle client communication, prepare and deliver monthly/quarterly presentations covering team performance, task updates, and security compliance status to senior management or steering committees.
Liaise with HR on team performance matters and participate in the hiring process by evaluating candidates based on role-specific requirements.
